extraction_point: after the SENSO parent prefix is reconstructed and before unchanged continuation

features.name: output_set_entropy
features.formula: -sum(p*log(p) for p in sizes/sum(sizes)) / log(13); sizes[i] = getNumSets() for channel i; 0 if all zero

features.name: depth_early_fraction
features.formula: comparators at index in [0, prefix_count/3) / prefix_count; 0 if prefix_count==0

features.name: depth_mid_fraction
features.formula: comparators at index in [prefix_count/3, 2*prefix_count/3) / prefix_count; 0 if prefix_count==0

features.name: depth_late_fraction
features.formula: comparators at index in [2*prefix_count/3, prefix_count) / prefix_count; 0 if prefix_count==0

features.name: prefix_symmetric
features.formula: 1.0 if for all i: (12-network[2*(prefix_count-1-i)+1], 12-network[2*(prefix_count-1-i)]) == (network[2*i], network[2*i+1]); else 0.0; 0 if prefix empty

group_C_progress_velocity.approximation_note: True per-comparator output-set deltas require per-step buffering. Features 95-97 use a cumulative proxy; feature 98 is approximated zero. These are declared limitations, not bugs.

features.name: stall_fraction_8
features.formula: APPROXIMATED_ZERO: 0.0 always; reserved for F4 repair

group_D_generation_context.approximation_note: Population rank and fitness history are not available at the reconstruction call site without invasive SENSO changes. Both features are constant 0.0. Reserved for F4 repair.

post_extraction_standardization.fit_on: training seeds 1-18 and extra seeds 1001-1020; computed fresh from training data (no v1 normalization reuse)
post_extraction_standardization.export: one mean and one scale per feature (101 values each) in checkpoint

explicit_omissions: No exact unsorted-input or counterexample enumeration: recomputing all 8192 inputs for every dataset row would materially change throughput.
No 44-comparator budget, indicator, label, reward, or feature.
No seed identifier, candidate identity, verifier result, wall time, or holdout metadata is a model input.
Group D features (99-100) are constant zero: population rank and fitness history not available at reconstruction call site.
Group C feature 98 (stall_fraction_8) is constant zero: per-comparator history not buffered.
